character.mortefi.name: Mortefi
character.mortefi.briefInfo: Gathers heat to create flames, which wrap around his arm like a wild red dragon. In the thick smoke, one can see the elegant form of a nobleman repelling enemies.
character.mortefi.skills.0.name: Impromptu Performance
character.mortefi.skills.0.description:
**Basic Attack**
Attack with dual pistols and flames up to 4 times consecutively, dealing Fusion DMG.

**Heavy Attack**
Enter aiming state and perform a more powerful shot. Deals Fusion DMG.

**Mid-air Attack**
Consume stamina to perform continuous attacks in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.

**Dodge Counter**
After a successful ==Dodge==, short press ==Basic Attack== to deal Fusion DMG.
character.mortefi.skills.1.name: Fury's Sonata
character.mortefi.skills.1.description: Shoot a high-speed flame lightning forward, dealing Fusion DMG.
character.mortefi.skills.2.name: Fury's Fugue
character.mortefi.skills.2.description:
**Resonance Skill: Fury's Fugue**
When Mortefi's "Fury Gauge" reaches 100, the ==Resonance Skill== is replaced by ==Fury's Fugue==. Consume all "Fury Gauge" to perform high-speed flame lightning attacks, dealing Fusion DMG which is treated as Resonance Skill DMG.

**"Fury Gauge" Acquisition Rules**
Max limit: 100pt.
Regain Fury Gauge when Basic Attack ==Impromptu Performance==, Intro Skill ==Dissonance==, or Resonance Skill ==Fury's Sonata== hits target.
Additionally, within 5s after casting ==Fury's Sonata==, Basic Attack ==Impromptu Performance== hits regain Fury Gauge.
character.mortefi.skills.3.name: Violent Finale
character.mortefi.skills.3.description:
Deals Fusion DMG and applies ==Dragon's Rhapsody== to all party members.

**Dragon's Rhapsody**
· When active character's ==Basic Attack== hits, trigger coordinated attack to fire 1 ==Coordinated Shot==.
· When active character's ==Heavy Attack== hits, trigger coordinated attack to fire 2 ==Coordinated Shots==.
· Trigger cooldown: 0.35s.

**Coordinated Shot**
Deals Fusion DMG.

character.chixia.skills.2.name: Hero's Passion

character.rococo.metadata.name: Rococo
character.rococo.metadata.brief: The mysterious box she always carries seems to contain the entire world── Ocher ribbons, shimmering sea-fireflies, and even joyful fireworks...
character.rococo.skills.0.name: Pello, Slowly
character.rococo.skills.0.description:
**Basic Attack**
Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing **Havoc DMG**.

**Heavy Attack**
Consumes Stamina to attack the target and deal **Havoc DMG**. If 「Imagination」 is 100pt or more upon hit, Rococo is launched into the air and enters the ==Illusion of Flight== state. Holding the Basic Attack button allows charging, gaining more 「Imagination」 the longer it is held, and charging can continue even if all Stamina is exhausted. Releasing the button or reaching the maximum charge time automatically triggers a Heavy Attack.

**Mid-air Attack**
Consumes Stamina to perform a mid-air plunging attack, dealing **Havoc DMG**.

**Dodge Counter**
After a successful ==Dodge==, short-pressing the Basic Attack button within a certain duration attacks the target and deals **Havoc DMG**.
character.rococo.skills.1.name: Difficult Setting
character.rococo.skills.1.description: Rococo projects the storm-like thinking power from her mind, pulling nearby targets and dealing **Havoc DMG**. Simultaneously, Rococo is launched into the air and enters the ==Illusion of Flight== state.
character.rococo.skills.2.name: Prop Master's Self-Cultivation
character.rococo.skills.2.description:
**Illusion of Flight**
· While Rococo is in the ==Illusion of Flight== state and possesses 100pt or more of 「Imagination」, short-pressing the Basic Attack button consumes 100pt of 「Imagination」 to trigger the Basic Attack ==Reality-Reflecting Illusion==.
· This state is canceled if Rococo is not in the air or is off-field.

**Basic Attack · Reality-Reflecting Illusion**
· Performs up to 3 consecutive attacks dealing **Havoc DMG**, which is considered **Heavy Attack DMG**. After the 1st and 2nd attacks land, if 「Imagination」 is 100pt or more, Rococo is launched into the air and enters the ==Illusion of Flight== state.

**Imagination Recovery Rules**
· Maximum 「Imagination」: 300pt
· Dealing DMG with Basic Attacks restores 「Imagination」.
· Holding the Basic Attack button to charge restores 「Imagination」.
· Casting Resonance Skill ==Difficult Setting== restores 100pt of 「Imagination」.
· Casting Intro Skill ==Pello, Help!== restores 100pt of 「Imagination」.
character.rococo.skills.3.name: Improvisational Performance, Start!
character.rococo.skills.3.description: Rococo's improvisational performance begins! Deals **Havoc DMG** to the target, which is considered **Heavy Attack DMG**. Upon casting, if Rococo's CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every 0.1% of excess CRIT Rate increases the party's ATK by 1pt for 30s, up to a maximum of 200pt.
character.rococo.skills.4.name: Pello, Help!
character.rococo.skills.4.description: Attacks the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**. Short-pressing the Basic Attack button within a certain duration after casting triggers the 4th stage of the Basic Attack.
character.rococo.skills.5.name: Thundering Applause
character.rococo.skills.5.description: The next Resonator's **Havoc DMG** is boosted by 20%, and **Basic Attack DMG** is boosted by 25% for 14s. The effect ends immediately if the character is switched.
character.rococo.additionalAbilities.0.d: When casting Resonance Skill or Heavy Attack, Rococo's ATK increases by 20% for 12s.
character.rococo.additionalAbilities.1.d:
After casting Outro Skill, the next Resonator's Exploration Tool is replaced by the ==Rare Box==.

**Rare Box**
· After use, pulls nearby targets toward the center of the ==Rare Box== and deals a total of 100pt of **Havoc DMG**, which is considered Exploration Tool DMG. Casting this skill is considered as casting an Echo Ability.
· The ==Rare Box== lasts for 14s. Switching to another character causes the ==Rare Box== to disappear immediately.

character.rococo.eidolons.5.name: Soaring on Golden Wings
character.rococo.eidolons.5.description:
Upon casting Resonance Liberation ==Improvisational Performance, Start!==, Rococo gains the following effects for 12s:
· Attacks with Basic Attack ==Reality-Reflecting Illusion== ignore 60% of the target's DEF.
· After the 3rd stage of Basic Attack ==Reality-Reflecting Illusion== lands, Rococo is launched into the air and enters the ==Illusion of Flight== state. Short-pressing the Basic Attack button at this time triggers the Basic Attack ==Reality Construction==. The ==Reality Construction== state will not be interrupted by enemy attacks and deals DMG equal to 100% of the 3rd stage of ==Reality-Reflecting Illusion==, which is considered **Heavy Attack DMG**.
· After ==Reality Construction== lands, Rococo is launched into the air and enters the ==Illusion of Flight== state. ==Reality Construction== can only be triggered while in the ==Illusion of Flight== state.

character.rover_havoc.skills.2.descripti:
**Devastation**
When 「Umbra」 is full, hold the ==Basic Attack== button to trigger ==Devastation==, dealing **Havoc DMG** to the target. This damage is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

**Dark Surge State**
After triggering ==Devastation==, Rover enters the ==Dark Surge== state, gaining the following effects:
· ==Basic Attack== is converted into ==Enhanced Basic Attack==, allowing up to 5 consecutive attacks and dealing **Havoc DMG**.
· ==Heavy Attack== is converted into ==Enhanced Heavy Attack==.
· After triggering ==Enhanced Heavy Attack==, short-press the ==Basic Attack== button to trigger ==Thundering Blade==, dealing **Havoc DMG** to the target. This damage is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
· After triggering Heavy Attack ==Thundering Blade==, short-press the ==Basic Attack== button to trigger the ==3rd stage of Enhanced Basic Attack==, dealing **Havoc DMG** to the target.
· Resonance Skill ==Blade of Tranquility== is converted into Resonance Skill ==Lifeloss==, transforming melody into a blade to attack the target and deal **Havoc DMG**.

**Umbra Accumulation Rules**
Maximum 「Umbra」: 100pt.
「Umbra」 is accumulated when Basic Attack ==Tunes of the Feather== hits a target.
「Umbra」 is accumulated when Resonance Skill ==Blade of Tranquility== is cast.
「Umbra」 is accumulated when Resonance Skill ==Lifeloss== is cast.
「Umbra」 is accumulated when Intro Skill ==Fury Wave== is cast.

character.camellya.briefInfo:
Red light blooms in layers from the tips of her hair, and vines entwine around her, stretching out in all directions.

character.camellya.skills.0.name: Basic Attack
character.camellya.skills.0.description:
**Basic Attack**
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing **Havoc DMG**.
After performing ==3rd stage of Basic Attack== or Heavy Attack ==Pruning==, hold the ==Basic Attack== button to continuously attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**.
After the ==4th stage of Basic Attack== ends, automatically trigger the ==5th stage of Basic Attack==.

**Heavy Attack: Pruning**
Consume Stamina to attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**.

**Mid-air Attack**
Consume Stamina to perform a plunging attack from mid-air, dealing **Havoc DMG**.

**Dodge Counter**
Short-press the ==Basic Attack== button after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**.
character.camellya.skills.1.name: Dance of Bloom and Decay
character.camellya.skills.1.description:
**Blooming Camellia**
Attacks the target, dealing **Havoc DMG** and entering the ==Blooming== state. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

**Blooming State**
· Camellya cannot move while entwined by vines.
· ==Basic Attack== and Heavy Attack ==Pruning== are replaced by Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines==, performing up to 4 consecutive attacks and dealing **Havoc DMG**. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
· When triggering Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines Stage 3==, hold the ==Basic Attack== button to trigger Basic Attack ==Flaming Dance of Vines==, dealing **Havoc DMG**, and automatically trigger Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines Stage 4==.
· ==Dodge Counter== is replaced by Dodge Counter ==Atonement==. After a successful Dodge, short-press the ==Basic Attack== button to attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
· ==Resonance Skill== is replaced by Resonance Skill ==Heart of Dark Pistil==. When casting ==Heart of Dark Pistil==, attacks the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
· Resonance Skill ==Heart of Dark Pistil== can be cast in mid-air.
· After casting Resonance Skill ==Heart of Dark Pistil==, the ==Blooming== state ends.
· When triggering ==Control==, the ==Blooming== state ends.
· Jump is replaced by Basic Attack ==Spinning Dance==. Short-press the Jump button to consume Stamina and attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG, and the ==Blooming== state ends.
· Casting Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines== or ==Flaming Dance of Vines== in mid-air consumes Stamina.
· Stamina cannot be recovered while casting Resonance Skill ==Heart of Dark Pistil==.
· Continuously consumes Stamina while entwined by vines in mid-air.
character.camellya.skills.2.name: Botanical Universe
character.camellya.skills.2.description:
**Botanical Universe**
When hitting a target with ==Basic Attack==, Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines==, ==Flaming Dance of Vines==, ==Spinning Dance==, Dodge Counter ==Atonement==, Resonance Skill ==Blooming Camellia==, or ==Heart of Dark Pistil==, consumes 「Red Camellia · Pistil」, and the Base Resonance Energy Regen of that attack is increased by 150%.
For every 10pt of 「Red Camellia · Pistil」 consumed, restores 4pt of Concerto Energy and gains 1 stack of 「Red Camellia · Bud」, lasting for 15s and stacking up to 10 times.

**Resonance Circuit: Bloom in a Moment**
When Concerto Energy is full and ==Bloom in a Moment== is available, the Resonance Skill is replaced by ==Bloom in a Moment==.
When casting ==Bloom in a Moment==, consumes 70pt of Concerto Energy to attack the target, dealing **Havoc DMG**. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Upon casting ==Bloom in a Moment==, enters the ==Ephemera== state.
Can be cast in mid-air.

**Ephemera State**
· ==Sweet Dream==: Increases the DMG multipliers of ==Basic Attack==, Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines==, ==Flaming Dance of Vines==, ==Spinning Dance==, Dodge Counter ==Atonement==, Resonance Skill ==Blooming Camellia==, and ==Heart of Dark Pistil== by 50%.
· When casting ==Bloom in a Moment==, removes all 「Red Camellia · Bud」. For each stack of 「Red Camellia · Bud」, the DMG multiplier increase of ==Sweet Dream== is further increased by 5%, up to a maximum of 50% additional increase.
· While in the ==Ephemera== state, 「Red Camellia · Bud」 cannot be gained.
· While in the ==Ephemera== state, the Base Resonance Energy Regen of ==Basic Attack==, Basic Attack ==Dance of Vines==, ==Flaming Dance of Vines==, ==Spinning Dance==, Dodge Counter ==Atonement==, Resonance Skill ==Blooming Camellia==, and ==Heart of Dark Pistil== is reduced to 0%.
· Switching to another character immediately ends the ==Ephemera== state.
· When all 「Red Camellia · Pistil」 are consumed, the ==Ephemera== state ends immediately.

**「Red Camellia · Pistil」 Accumulation Rules**
Maximum 「Red Camellia · Pistil」: 100pt.
When casting Intro Skill ==Eternal Spring==, restores 100pt of 「Red Camellia · Pistil」.
When casting Resonance Circuit ==Bloom in a Moment==, restores 100pt of 「Red Camellia · Pistil」.
